### Welcome!

I am a Research Engineer/Scientist, I build end-to-end AI systems for health from data aquisition and hardware–AI co-design to representation learning and deployment. My work integrates multiple biomedical data modalities, and more recently, generative models to uncover clinically meaningful digital biomarkers and enable scalable, data-driven healthcare.
